Baseline coverage matrix for current HolSmt parser, HOL-to-SMT-LIB translator, solver entry points, and Z3 proof replay. This is not a completeness claim.

Current coverage records the implementation state observed in source and executable tests. COMPLETE-required coverage records the stricter target: rows are `reconstructed` only when real complete evidence exists, `red` while implementation obligations remain, and `not_applicable` only with an explicit scope reason.
